game.title.description: Name of the Blackjack game card on the home screen.
game.title.notes: Do not translate the game name.

game.description.description: One-line description on the Blackjack game card.

game.playLabel.description: Accessibility label for the Blackjack play button.

bet.label.description: Label above the bet amount input.

bet.accessibilityLabel.description: Screen reader label for the current bet stepper value.

actions.deal.description: Button label to deal cards and start a hand.

actions.dealLabel.description: Accessibility label for the Deal button.

actions.hit.description: Button label to take another card.

actions.hitLabel.description: Accessibility label for the Hit button.

actions.stand.description: Button label to end the player's turn.

actions.standLabel.description: Accessibility label for the Stand button.

actions.doubleDown.description: Button label to double the bet and take one card.

actions.doubleDownLabel.description: Accessibility label for the Double Down button when enabled.

actions.doubleDownDisabledLabel.description: Accessibility label for the Double Down button when disabled.

actions.split.description: Button label to split a pair into two hands (enabled state).

actions.splitLabel.description: Accessibility label for the Split button when splitting is available.

actions.splitDisabledLabel.description: Accessibility label for the Split button when splitting is not available.

hand.player.description: Label above the player's hand of cards.

hand.dealer.description: Label above the dealer's hand of cards.

hand.playerHand.description: Label above each player hand when the hand has been split into multiple hands.
hand.playerHand.notes: The limit counts the raw {{number}} placeholder.

hand.value.description: Displays the numeric value of a hard hand.

card.accessibilityLabel.description: Screen reader label for a visible playing card.
card.accessibilityLabel.notes: rank and suit are interpolated; suit uses card.suit.* keys.

card.faceDown.description: Screen reader label for a face-down card.

card.suit.spades.description: Name of the Spades suit for screen reader use.

card.suit.hearts.description: Name of the Hearts suit for screen reader use.

card.suit.diamonds.description: Name of the Diamonds suit for screen reader use.

card.suit.clubs.description: Name of the Clubs suit for screen reader use.

outcome.blackjack.description: Result banner when player gets a natural blackjack.

outcome.blackjackNatural.description: Result banner on the table when the player's natural blackjack wins; says it pays 3 to 2 (#3621).

outcome.blackjackNaturalLabel.description: Screen-reader label for the table's "Blackjack! 3:2" banner: says the 3:2 payout in words, so it is not read as "3 colon 2" (#3621).
outcome.blackjackNaturalLabel.notes: Spoken, not shown. Use the natural way to say a 3-to-2 payout in the language.

outcome.push.description: Result banner when the hand is a tie (push).

payout.positive.description: Payout display when player wins chips (positive).
payout.positive.notes: Leading + sign should be preserved if possible.

payout.negative.description: Payout display when player loses chips (negative). amount is already negative.

payout.zero.description: Payout display for a push (no chips exchanged).

payout.accessibilityLabel.description: Screen reader label for the payout value.

tag.win.description: A split hand's own result tag, shown on the hand after the round ("WIN"; drawn in capitals).
tag.win.notes: Must fit a split hand's one-line result label with the total and a 3-digit payout (#3782): about 60 px drawn in capitals (German VERLUST, 7 Latin capitals, fits). Russian uses Минус for lose. Measure again (tableGeometry.test.ts) after a change.

tag.lose.description: A split hand's own result tag when it lost ("LOSE"; drawn in capitals).
tag.lose.notes: See tag.win: about 60 px drawn in capitals (#3782).

tag.push.description: A split hand's own result tag when it tied the dealer ("PUSH"; drawn in capitals).
tag.push.notes: See tag.win: about 60 px drawn in capitals (#3782).

result.splitWon.description: Split round summary under the dealer: how many hands won, e.g. "Won: 1". Joined with the losses and pushes by " · ".
result.splitWon.notes: A label and a number, so no plural forms are needed.

result.splitLost.description: Split round summary: how many hands lost, e.g. "Lost: 2".
result.splitLost.notes: A label and a number, so no plural forms are needed.

result.splitPush.description: Split round summary: how many hands tied the dealer, e.g. "Push: 1".
result.splitPush.notes: A label and a number, so no plural forms are needed.

gameOver.title.description: Title of the game-over modal when the player runs out of chips.

betting.clearBet.description: Button label to clear the current bet back to zero.

betting.clearBetLabel.description: Accessibility label for the Clear bet button.

betting.tableLimits.description: Heading above the table's minimum and maximum bet range.

betting.tableLimitsRange.description: Displays the table's minimum and maximum bet in chips.
betting.tableLimitsRange.notes: The limit counts the raw {{min}}/{{max}} placeholders.

betting.tapToAdd.description: Instructional hint shown in the empty bet circle before any chips are added.

chip.addLabel.description: Accessibility label for a chip button when it can be added to the bet.

chip.disabledLabel.description: Accessibility label for a chip button when it cannot be added (exceeds table max or bankroll).

rules.title.description: Heading for the collapsible table rules panel.

rules.toggleLabel.description: Accessibility label for the button that expands or collapses the table rules panel.

rules.dealerSoft17.description: Row label for the dealer's soft-17 rule setting.

rules.s17.description: Abbreviation for "dealer stands on soft 17", shown on a segmented control.
rules.s17.notes: Standard blackjack rule abbreviation; keep it short and recognizable.

rules.h17.description: Abbreviation for "dealer hits on soft 17", shown on a segmented control.
rules.h17.notes: Standard blackjack rule abbreviation; keep it short and recognizable.

rules.s17Label.description: Accessibility label for the S17 (dealer stands on soft 17) rule option.

rules.h17Label.description: Accessibility label for the H17 (dealer hits on soft 17) rule option.

rules.deckCount.description: Row label for the number of decks shuffled into the shoe.

rules.decreaseDeckLabel.description: Accessibility label for the button that decreases the deck count.

rules.increaseDeckLabel.description: Accessibility label for the button that increases the deck count.

rules.penetration.description: Row label for the shoe penetration percentage setting.

rules.decreasePenetrationLabel.description: Accessibility label for the button that decreases shoe penetration.

rules.increasePenetrationLabel.description: Accessibility label for the button that increases shoe penetration.

rules.soft17TooltipLabel.description: Accessibility label for the info button that opens the dealer soft-17 rule tooltip.

rules.decksTooltipLabel.description: Accessibility label for the info button that opens the deck-count tooltip.

rules.penetrationTooltipLabel.description: Accessibility label for the info button that opens the penetration tooltip.

rules.soft17Tooltip.description: Explanatory tooltip text describing the S17/H17 dealer rule and its effect on the odds.

rules.decksTooltip.description: Explanatory tooltip text describing how deck count affects the house edge and card counting.

rules.penetrationTooltip.description: Explanatory tooltip text describing shoe penetration and its effect on variance.

rules.standardTitle.description: Heading for the fixed rules every table plays by, under the adjustable ones.

rules.standard.description: The fixed rules (#3741): a blackjack (natural) pays 3:2; the dealer checks for blackjack when showing an Ace or a ten-value card, and a dealer blackjack ends the hand for the original bet only (a push against the player's blackjack); a blackjack beats any other 21.
rules.standard.notes: Keep 3:2 as written. 'Blackjack' as each locale already writes it in this namespace.

score.heroLabel.description: Hero label above the primary scorecard stat (net chip profit/loss for the session).

score.plLine.description: Displays the session's net profit/loss in chips as the scorecard hero value.

score.subLine.description: Subtitle under the scorecard hero showing hands played and win rate.

score.subLineEmpty.description: Subtitle shown when no hands have been played yet this session.

score.chipBalance.description: Stat tile label for the player's current chip balance.

score.biggestWin.description: Stat tile label for the biggest single-hand win this session.

score.handsWon.description: Stat tile label for the number of hands won this session.

score.handsLost.description: Stat tile label for the number of hands lost this session.

score.blackjacks.description: Stat tile label for the number of natural blackjacks dealt this session.

score.busts.description: Stat tile label for the number of hands that busted this session.

hud.goalProgressAccessibilityLabel.description: Accessibility label for the run's goal progress bar.

hud.criticalWarning.description: Warning shown in the HUD when the player's bankroll is critically low.
hud.criticalWarning.notes: Keep the ⚠ symbol or replace with the locale's usual warning symbol.

hud.winStreakBadge.description: Badge shown in the HUD highlighting the player's current win streak.
hud.winStreakBadge.notes: Keep the 🔥 emoji; the limit counts the raw {{count}} placeholder.

table.beginner.description: Name of the Beginner difficulty table on the table-select screen.

table.beginner.subtitle.description: Short tagline under the Beginner table name.

table.intermediate.description: Name of the Intermediate difficulty table on the table-select screen.

table.intermediate.subtitle.description: Short tagline under the Intermediate table name.

table.highRoller.description: Name of the High Roller difficulty table on the table-select screen.

table.highRoller.subtitle.description: Short tagline under the High Roller table name.

tableSelect.kicker.description: Small uppercase kicker above the table-select headline.

tableSelect.taglineSub.description: Explanatory subtitle under the table-select headline.

tableSelect.startChips.description: Stat label for a table's starting chip count.

tableSelect.goal.description: Stat label for a table's chip goal.

tableSelect.betRange.description: Stat label for a table's min–max bet range.

tableSelect.locked.description: Hint on a locked table card naming the table that must be completed first.

tableSelect.selectLabel.description: Accessibility label for an unlocked, selectable table card.

tableSelect.lockedLabel.description: Accessibility label for a locked table card.

tableSelect.viewHistory.description: Link label that opens the run history/stats screen from table select.

victory.subtitle.description: Subtitle on the victory screen naming the table just completed.

victory.goalLine.description: Displays the chip goal that was reached, on the victory screen.

victory.keepPlaying.description: Button label to keep playing the same table without a goal.

victory.keepPlayingLabel.description: Accessibility label for the Keep Playing button.

victory.nextTable.description: Button label to move up and play the next unlocked table.

victory.nextTableLabel.description: Accessibility label for the button that moves up to the next table.

victory.unlocked.description: Announces a card deck or reward unlocked by completing the run.

milestone.toast.description: Toast announcing a chip milestone reached during a run.

hud.winStreakAccessibilityLabel.description: Accessibility label for the win streak badge.

comeback.banner.description: Banner celebrating a comeback after being critically low on chips.

comeback.bannerAccessibilityLabel.description: Accessibility label for the comeback banner.

allIn.badge.description: Badge shown when the player bets their entire bankroll.

allIn.badgeAccessibilityLabel.description: Accessibility label for the All In badge.

stats.title.description: Title of the run statistics screen.

stats.currentRun.description: Section heading for the in-progress run's stats.

stats.currentRunEmpty.description: Empty-state text shown when there is no current run.

stats.chipsLabel.description: Stat label for the current chip count.

stats.handsLabel.description: Stat label for the hands-played and win-rate summary.

stats.hands.description: Displays a number of hands played.

stats.biggestWin.description: Stat label for the biggest single-hand win in the current run.

stats.biggestWinAmount.description: Displays the biggest win amount with a leading plus sign.
stats.biggestWinAmount.notes: Leading + sign should be preserved if possible.

stats.netPL.description: Stat label for the run's net profit/loss.
stats.netPL.notes: P/L is a common finance abbreviation for profit/loss; adapt to the locale's usual short form.

stats.netPLPositive.description: Displays a positive net profit/loss amount.
stats.netPLPositive.notes: Leading + sign should be preserved if possible.

stats.netPLNegative.description: Displays a negative net profit/loss amount (amount is already negative).

stats.allTimeBest.description: Section heading for all-time best stats across runs.

stats.allTimeBestRun.description: Stat label for the best completed run's final chip count.

stats.allTimeMostHands.description: Stat label for the run with the most hands played.

stats.allTimeBiggestComeback.description: Stat label for the largest bankroll comeback across all runs.

stats.comebackLow.description: Displays how low the bankroll got before the biggest comeback.

stats.runHistory.description: Section heading for the list of past runs.

stats.noRuns.description: Empty-state text shown when there is no run history yet.

stats.runOutcome.completed.description: Outcome tag on a run-history row for a run that reached its goal.

stats.runOutcome.busted.description: Outcome tag on a run-history row for a run that ended in a bust.

stats.runOutcome.comeback.description: Outcome tag on a run-history row for a run that recovered from a critical low.

stats.runOutcome.abandoned.description: Outcome tag on a run-history row for a run the player left before reaching the goal or running out of chips.

stats.viewStats.description: Link label that opens the run statistics screen.

stats.viewStatsLabel.description: Accessibility label for the link that opens the run statistics screen.

stats.runAccessibilityLabel.description: Accessibility label summarizing a row in the run history list.

tableSelect.lastPlayed.description: Tag on the table card the player's last run was played at, so they can pick it again. Also read as the card's screen-reader hint.

a11y.dealerScore.description: Screen-reader label for the dealer's visible hand total.

a11y.dealerScoreHidden.description: Screen-reader label for the dealer's total while the hole card is face down.

a11y.playerScore.description: Screen-reader label for the player's hand total.

actions.change.description: Dock button after a hand: clear the bet and pick a new one.
actions.change.notes: Short: shares a row with Rebet and 2×.

actions.changeLabel.description: Accessibility label for the Change button.

actions.rebet.description: Dock button after a hand: deal again with the same bet. The amount is shown beside it.
actions.rebet.notes: Short: shares a row with Change and 2×.

actions.rebetLabel.description: Accessibility label for the Rebet button.

actions.doubleBet.description: Dock button after a hand: deal again with double the last bet. The amount is shown beside it.
actions.doubleBet.notes: A symbol: 2 times. Keep it as is unless your script writes it differently.

result.dealerBusts.description: Result detail under the result banner: the dealer went over 21.
result.dealerBusts.notes: value is the dealer's total, e.g. 22.

result.playerBusts.description: Result detail under the result banner: the player went over 21.

result.versus.description: Result detail under the result banner: the two totals compared.
result.versus.notes: player and dealer are hand totals, e.g. 18 against the dealer's 20.

result.dealerHas.description: Result detail after a split: the dealer's final total.

result.dealerBlackjack.description: Result detail under the result banner: the dealer's two-card 21 (a natural, found by its peek) beat the player.
result.dealerBlackjack.notes: 'Blackjack' as each locale already writes it in this namespace.

result.bothBlackjack.description: Result detail under the Push banner: the player and the dealer both have a two-card 21 (a natural).
result.bothBlackjack.notes: 'Blackjack' as each locale already writes it in this namespace.

a11y.handBet.description: Accessibility label part for a hand's bet.
